name: Marshall Islands
summary_text: The Marshall Islands demands real caution. Same-sex conduct legal; US-associated; no LGR; no documented anti-trans pattern; very thin data. Caveat: very small population — the evidence base is thin, so this assessment carries greater-than-usual uncertainty.

sources.claim_summary: ILGA World Database jurisdiction page for the Marshall Islands: documents the legal status — same-sex conduct decriminalised, with constitutional non-discrimination provisions.

sources.title: Human Dignity Trust
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: Only the Human Dignity Trust homepage was retrievable at fetch time (no Marshall Islands-specific page); the Marshall Islands does not criminalise same-sex conduct.

sources.title: A History of LGBT Criminalisation | Human Dignity Trust
sources.claim_summary: Human Dignity Trust: 'A History of LGBT Criminalisation' - almost 500 years of outlawing LGBT people; overview of criminalising jurisdictions and strategic litigation (Marshall Islands context: no criminalisation).

US State Department 2015 Human Rights Report for Marshall Islands: significant problems were prison conditions, corruption and domestic violence; no reports of torture, arbitrary killings or disappearances - no LGBT-specific abuses reported.

sources.title: Over 80 Nations Support Statement at Human Rights Council on LGBT Rights - U.S. Mission to International Organizations in Geneva
sources.claim_summary: US Mission in Geneva (March 2011): post on LGBT rights in the UN context - US diplomatic advocacy for SOGI rights at the Human Rights Council, relevant to the Marshall Islands' international human-rights environment.

sources.title: Marshall Islands | Pacific Sexual & Gender Diversity Network | Suva
sources.claim_summary: PSGDN Pacific LGBTQI Network, Marshall Islands page: profile of Anfernee Nenol Kaminaga, a 25-year-old pansexual genderqueer Marshall Islander who co-created and led 'Brighten the Rainbow' - known as the first openly LGBTIQ initiative in the Marshall Islands; also a UNESCO Youth Ambassador and UN Youth Climate Action Summit representative.
